title: Fix: Admin Test Mode broke every button on the main screen
changes: renderAdminTestMode() was called at script load time, before WORD_CHAPTER_SIZE (a const used by wordChapterCount()) was initialised. While in Admin Test Mode, the lesson-jump control's setup code called wordChapterCount(), which threw 'Cannot access WORD_CHAPTER_SIZE before initialization' — an uncaught error that silently aborted the rest of the script, including every button click handler defined later in the file (Continue Adventure, Start next lesson, Study, Settings, everything).
Outside Admin Test Mode this branch never ran, so the bug was invisible until the test-learner banner was active — matching the reported symptom of nothing working until exiting test mode.
Fix: moved the renderAdminTestMode() call to after WORD_CHAPTER_SIZE/wordChapterCount/chapterWords are declared. No other behavior changed.
